scenarios.title: Recover public save refusal
plannedActions: Only a persistent session-created synthetic workspace, unprivileged matching real/effective uid, no symlinks or foreign-owned descendants. Read/search remain; remove only owner-write on existing history via verified descriptor, require W_OK EACCES, restore exact mode in finally before resume. No journal/capability injection.
Save sentinel, import independent generation fixture, edit Mara biography via Characters and Save character once. No script/cue draft or provider action.

Require the actual Scriv save-error alert for the synthetic title and failure-status state. Observe but never dismiss the alert. Keep all package bytes unchanged and one naturally written pending record. Repair history permissions, verify the same alert remains, then relaunch only the owned process. Require exact retained record and original canonical bytes BEFORE normal Projects open, or fail without recovery credit. The existing relaunch may use SIGTERM or SIGKILL; no graceful-exit or lifecycle-callback claim.

Normal open recovers; independently expect only biography, one revision and finite nondecreasing modifiedAt. Verify original history/sentinel and all other package content; repeat cold open with no new writes.
expectedOutcomes: Expected real save-error alert and failure-status state, accepted biography-only model and one local journal, with all saved package bytes unchanged before and after repaired owned-process relaunch; the alert is never dismissed and termination mode is not claimed.

Normal Projects open loads the exact accepted model/date witnesses, acknowledges pending record and writes one exact expected history revision while preserving prior history and sentinel bytes; repeated cold open changes nothing.
